newsitem.title: USA: DAMARK says court affirms claims dismissal.
newsitem.headline: DAMARK says court affirms claims dismissal.

text.p: DAMARK International Inc said Thursday the Minnesota Supreme Court has unanimously affirmed a dismissal of all claims asserted by DLH Inc against it, Chairman Mark Cohn and company co-founder David Russ.
DAMARK said this decision terminates the claims first brought by DLH in March 1995, asserting rights to a large block of DAMARK stock owned by Russ.
The claims were dismissed in 1995 and the Minnesota Court of Appeals affirmed the dismissal in 1996, DAMARK said.
DAMARK said its counterclaims against DLH are not affected by the ruling. The company said it intends to pursue vigorously its counterclaims at a trial later this year.
DAMARK is a direct marketing company.
